fusions.name: Tangle Line
fusions.desc: Flings a snarl of strands that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bristle Storm
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stiff quills at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Prickled Nest
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Twitching Whiskers
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
